title: 9 Things a Godly Man Learns From Boaz Before He Ever Meets Her
caption:
Everyone wants to find a Ruth. Almost nobody asks how to become a Boaz.

Read Ruth 2 to 4 again. By the time she shows up, he's already a man worth marrying. He works. He blesses his crew. He notices the overlooked. He protects before he pursues. He gives more than he has to, guards her reputation, does things the right way, and keeps his word.

None of that started when he met her. It's who he already was.

Chase God. Become that man. Let Him handle the timing.

Save this. Read Ruth this week.

theme: He chases God, not a wife.
